candidates.change_summary: Replace the require that msg.sender is owner with a require that tx.origin is owner, allowing externally owned accounts through delegated calls to be treated differently.
Change the visibility guard to require that msg.sender is not the owner, inverting the authorization check so only non-owners can withdraw.
Remove the require guard entirely so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Change the transfer recipient from the provided _recipient to the contract owner, so funds always go to owner regardless of argument.
Change transfer to send zero value instead of full balance, leaving contract balance unchanged.
Replace transfer of the full balance with transfer of half the balance (integer division), changing the amount withdrawn.
Insert a state-changing assignment that sets owner to _recipient before transfer, changing post-call owner observed externally.
Replace transfer with a low-level call that forwards all gas and returns a boolean; revert on failure, which can change behaviour on recipient fallback.
